name: dsh-break-switch
description: DSH plugin that switches the macOS frontmost app to a break target (an app or browser page) while an agent is running, then switches back when it finishes

scripts.smoke:front: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to set frontApp to name of first application process whose frontmost is true'
scripts.smoke:app: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of first process whose name is "VSCode" to true'
